objective: Candidate turns a pizza while leaving it on the oven deck; PR-2208 turns over a taped carton, cuts its bottom tape, opens all bottom flaps, and collapses the carton flat.
physical_skill: Candidate requires thin-peel insertion and small tangential strokes; PR-2208 requires whole-carton turnover, guarded cutting along three tape paths, flap articulation, and controlled structural collapse.
success_condition: Candidate scores released yaw with continuous deck contact and no food damage. PR-2208 gives milestones for valid cutting and outward flap opening, with full credit for a released flattened carton, parked cutter, intact creases, and hands clear.
reason: Carton turnover is only an initial prerequisite to a cutting-and-flattening task and does not test the candidate's center-preserving under-edge rotation.
